name: @peardrop/cli
description: PearDrop CLI: Secure, ephemeral file/secret drops for agents and humans

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @peardrop/core run build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts src/commands/*.ts src/commands/test/*.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=dist --alias:@peardrop/core/relay=../core/dist/relay.js --alias:@peardrop/core/node=../core/src/node.ts --alias:@peardrop/core=../core/src/index.ts --external:@noble/hashes --external:@noble/hashes/* --external:@oclif/core --external:@x402/core --external:@x402/core/* --external:@x402/evm --external:@x402/evm/* --external:effect --external:effect/* --external:hyperdht --external:open --external:viem --external:viem/* --external:ws --external:zod
